name.ja: 30MM 1/144 bEXM-33QB ヴォルパノヴァ(クアッドバイクVer.)

description.ja: 30MMバイロン軍に可変型の新機体「ヴォルパノヴァ」が登場！
description.en: A new variable type aircraft "Volpanova" appears in the 30MM Byron army!

description.ja: • 「クアッドバイク」形態に変形可能な新機体。
description.en: • A new aircraft that can transform into a "quad bike" form.

description.ja: • 変形工程にはロック機構を搭載し、変形後のシルエットも安定。
description.en: • The deformation process is equipped with a locking mechanism to ensure a stable silhouette after deformation.

description.ja: • カスタマイズのアレンジで人型と車両型の中間形態も表現可能。
description.en: • Intermediate forms between human and vehicle types can be expressed through customization.

description.ja: • 武装はバズーカが付属。
description.en: • A bazooka is included as a weapon.

description.ja: • 既存機体やオプションパーツとのカスタマイズも可能。 無限のカスタマイズで自分だけの量産機を作り出せ！
description.en: • Can also be customized with existing aircraft and optional parts. Create your own mass-produced machine with unlimited customization!
